	["rbxassetid://112831415092272"] = true,
	["rbxassetid://105131259038903"] = true
}

local function getTimeFromImage(image, tableMap)
	if not image then return nil end

	for i = 1, 12 do
		local id = tableMap[i]
		if id and image:find(id) then
			return i
		end
	end

	return nil
end

local function runQuiz()
	local gui = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui"):WaitForChild("ClockQuiz")
	local frame = gui:FindFirstChild("Frame")
	local question = frame and (frame:FindFirstChild("Question") or frame:FindFirstChild("QuestionTroll"))
	local choices = frame and frame:FindFirstChild("Choices")

	if not (question and choices) then return end

	local totalMinute = nil
	local totalHour = nil
	local currentOp = "+"

	for _, obj in ipairs(question:GetChildren()) do

		if obj:IsA("ImageLabel") and obj.Name == "Symbol" then

			if plusIds[obj.Image] then
				currentOp = "+"
			elseif minusIds[obj.Image] then
				currentOp = "-"
			elseif equalIds[obj.Image] then
				break
			end

		elseif obj:IsA("Frame") and obj.Name == "Clock" then

			local min = obj:FindFirstChild("Minute")
			local hr = obj:FindFirstChild("Hour")

			local minVal = min and getTimeFromImage(min.Image, mtable)
			local hrVal = hr and getTimeFromImage(hr.Image, htable)

			if minVal and hrVal then

				if not totalMinute then
					totalMinute = minVal
					totalHour = hrVal
				else
					if currentOp == "+" then
						totalMinute += minVal
						totalHour += hrVal
					elseif currentOp == "-" then
						totalMinute -= minVal
						totalHour -= hrVal
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end

	while totalMinute > 12 do
		totalMinute -= 12
		totalHour += 1
	end

	while totalMinute < 1 do
		totalMinute += 12
		totalHour -= 1
	end

	while totalHour > 12 do
		totalHour -= 12
	end

	while totalHour < 1 do
		totalHour += 12
	end

	local exactMatch = nil
	local minuteFallback = nil

	for _, ans in ipairs(choices:GetChildren()) do
		if ans:IsA("ImageButton") then

			local min = ans:FindFirstChild("Minute")
			local hr = ans:FindFirstChild("Hour")

			local minVal = min and getTimeFromImage(min.Image, mtable)
			local hrVal = hr and getTimeFromImage(hr.Image, htable)

			if minVal == totalMinute and not minuteFallback then
				minuteFallback = ans
			end

			if hrVal == totalHour and minVal == totalMinute then
				exactMatch = ans
				break
			end
		end
	end

	local selected = exactMatch or minuteFallback

	if selected then
		Notification:Notify(
			{
				Title = exactMatch and "Exact Match" or "Fallback",
				Description = "Answer: " .. selected.Name
			},
			{
				OutlineColor = Color3.fromRGB(80, 80, 80),
				Time = 5,
				Type = "default"
			}
		)
	end
end

local library = loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Turtle-Brand/Turtle-Lib/main/source.lua"))()
local window = library:Window("Chronos Clock Solver")

window:Button("Notify Correct Answer", function()
   runQuiz()
end)
window:Button("Destroy GUI", function()
   window:Destroy()
end)
